coverage.summary: Covers residential rental property in the City of San Diego. Residential rental property is defined by reference to § 98.0702 as any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including units in a mobilehome park. The ordinance states no unit-count, building-age, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits. The Division 7 exemptions in § 98.0703 are not incorporated into this Division; only the definitions are.

result.notes: The summary was revised to describe covered buildings rather than conduct by sellers and landlords. Division 11 adopts only the § 98.0702 definitions (landlord, lease, residential rental property, tenant). It does not incorporate the § 98.0703 exemptions, which by their terms apply only to Division 7, such as the 15-year certificate-of-occupancy, owner-occupied and affordable-housing exemptions. So no building-level exemptions apply. requires_unknown_facts is set to false because the rule covers ordinary rental buildings. The exclusions for affordable-housing-guideline software and aggregated historical or public data reports define which devices are covered, not which buildings, so they are not listed as unverifiable exemptions. The measure is a proposed ordinance (O-2025-107) with a blank passage date in the documents. It takes effect 30 days after final passage, so its status remains pending. The remedies appear in § 98.1104, which is present in full in D076 and DX05.
